content: Responsibilities toward Believers
Hak wūkw qa qöhqöyat, naynihqat pan aw pās yuaatamantani; pu pay aṅ qa wūwukwmuy uhtupkomnihqat pan’i,
Pu aṅ wūwukwmuy momoymuy úṅumnihqat pan’i, pu pay qa wūwukwmuy uhsiwamnihqat pan’i, qanānaphin wūwank̇aṅwo.
Pu um aṅ koṅnanalvutuy pas antsa nanalvutuy k̇aptsi’tani.
Kurs haqawa koṅnalavu tímuy’taqw, sen mö́muy’taqw, pay puma tuwat put pāsye’, kiy aw wikye’, pep tavi’yuṅwmantani. Yan puma God unaṅwveyani. Pi pam aṅ tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi put tuṅlay’ta.
Noqw i’ hapi pas antsa nalqatqa God aw yank̇aṅw, mimhikqat, pu talöṅwiwmaqat aṅ yūmosa put aw okiwhtimaṅwu, pu nāwakinmaṅwu.
Nawus pi koṅnalavu kwaṅwáewhqatqa nāt as tayk̇aṅw pay soñawnen mokpuniṅwu.
Yan um pumuy amumi hiṅqawmaqw, puma qa hihta akw hinyuṅwni.

Kurs haqawa sinomuy hihta akw yesniqat amuṅem qa hintsak̇e’, tis pi ōviy pas amum ki’yuṅqamuy amuṅem pam qa pantsak̇e’, pam hapi tuptsiwniy ayo yuki’tani; nihqe qatuptsiwni’taqat epnihqe pas qa súantani.
Pu i’ hak koṅnalavu payhp sunat yahsaṅwni’taqa pas sūs puwsuṅwtaqw, pay um púmuy‐sa koṅnanalvutuy pan pohtoylani’tani.

I’ hak pan pohtoylaniwhqa hapi hihta lolmat hintsakqey akw aw navotiwtamantani, timuy suan wuṅwnaqa pīwu, hakimuy kiy ep pās ōoyhqee, pu God sinomuyatuy kukyamuy pāhomhqee, pu hihta akw okiwhinyuṅqamuy ep amumi unaṅwtapqee, pu hihta lomahintsatskiwhqat aṅ ahsupoq aṅ hinmaqee.
Nīk̇aṅw um aṅ momoyhoymuy koṅnanalvutuy pay qa nakwhani, taq puma Christ qa hihtatote’, pahsat puwsuṅwtotaniqey unaṅwtotiṅwu;
Nen qaanhtotiṅwu, motivasiwniy ayo yukuyaṅwuniqee.

Puma pantote’, qa hihta hintsatsk̇at, panis tuwat kīnawit yuṅtinumyaṅwu. Pu puma qa panis panyuṅwt, hīhihta yuaatotaṅwu; qa nāp hihta himuy aṅ sus’itsyaṅwu, pay as hihta qa yuaatotanik̇aṅw soq pantsatsk̇aṅwu.
Paniqw ōviy nuyniqw puma puwsuṅwtote’ tiy’ooyyani; nen kiy, pu timuy amumi tunatyawyuṅwni. Noqw sinom amumiq hiṅqaqwaqam pāpu qa hiṅqaqwani.
Taq haqawat pay Satan aw lasya.

Kurs haqawat tāqat sen wuhtit tuptsiwni’taqat ahpiyviat koṅnalvutiqw, pay pam put aw unaṅwtavi’tani; noqw God aw tōnawtaqam qa pumuy amumi enaṅ tūkwaiwyuṅwni. Nen puma aṅ pas qa atsat nanalvutuy amumi unaṅwtavi’yuṅwni.
Pu ima aṅ wukw’a’yat pas suan nuhtumi tunatyawyuṅqam pas pavan k̇aptsitiwyani, tis ōviy God lavayiyat yuaatotaqamu, pu tūtutuqaynayaqamu.
Pi ura tutuvenit aṅ yan pey’ta: Um wākasit söhövosit muritaqat motsóvuat qa sommantani, kita; pu piw yanwata: Pay tumalay’taqa ahsatiy hihk̇ay’taṅwu, yan’i.
Pu um wukw’ayat hihta qalománeveltoynayaqw, put qa kwúsumantani, ason pas lȫyöm sen pahyomhaqam put pas suyan navoti’yuṅqey paṅqaqwaqw, pu’ um aw tuwantamantani.
Pu aṅ qaanhintsatsk̇aqamuy sinmuy sohsokmuy amutpip u’nanamantani; noqw ahpiy sinom tsātsawnamantani.
Nu hapi God, pu Itahtutuyqawhqay Jesus Christ, pu pas namorstiwyaqamuy hoṅvia’yatuy amutpik ūmi pas paṅqawni: Um hapi qa hakiy sūkw‐sa pas hihtay’k̇aṅw, yan hinmani, qa sūkw‐sa eṅem tunatyawk̇aṅwo.
Pay um qa pas hakiy God tumalayat aw suhpanamantani, sen um qa pas aw hin suyan navoti’tee. Taq k̇a pam qaanhinmaqw, sinom uṅ aṅvaiwtaqat wūwayani. Um nāmi tunatyawte’, suan hinmani.
Pay um pāpu qa kūyit‐sa hīhikwt, pay hisaq wine hikwmantani, uhponoy qa kwaṅwáhintaṅwuniqw ōviy’o; pi um piép hinhtiṅwu.

Haqawatuy qaantsakpiam yep qatsit ep susmataqtiqw God amuṅem qalolmat yúkuniqw, pam pay navotiwta. Noqw pay haqawatuy qaanhintsakpiam tupkiwyuṅwa; nik̇aṅw ason hin yukiltiniqat aw pituqw pep pu’ sohsoy mātaqtini.
Pu pay ōviy piw pan haqawatuy lomahintsakpiam aṅwu pay mātaqya, pu ahpiy pay qa mātaqyaqa soon qa nāto mātaqtini.
